turns.message: How does receivables advance (antecipação) work with Getnet?
turns.response:
Receivables advance (antecipação) with Getnet allows you to receive your credit sales (one-time or in installments) ahead of schedule. It can be done manually or set up automatically through the Getnet Brasil app (available for Android and iOS).

### 1. Manual Advance via App
1. Open the Getnet Brasil app and log in.
2. Go to the "Serviços" menu and select "Antecipação de Vendas".
3. Choose the registered bank account to receive the funds.
4. Review and accept the terms.
5. Simulate the advance to check amounts, card brands, and fees, then click confirm.
6. Check the final amount and click "Antecipar".
7. Enter your password to complete the request. You can track the status in the "Meus Pedidos" area.
*(Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-antecipar-sua-vendas-pelo-app/, collected on 2026-11-07)*

### 2. Automatic Advance
You can enable or disable automatic advance directly in the app under "Serviços" > "Antecipação Automática" (requires an administrative profile and password). Requests to enable automatic advance can take up to 48 hours.
*(Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/, collected on 2026-11-07)*

### 3. Requirements and Fees
- **Minimum Amount:** The minimum balance required for an advance is R$ 50.00.
*(Sources: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-antecipar-sua-vendas-pelo-app/ and https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-antecipacao-de-venda/como-habilitar-antecipacao-automatica-pelo-app/, collected on 2026-11-07)*
- **Fees:** Specific rates for receivables advance can be checked through the Getnet Brasil App or the Getnet Client Portal under your contract or rate details.
*(Source: https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-taxas/taxas-por-transacao/, collected on 2026-11-07)*
